rubric.role_summary: Senior product manager for electric-vehicle financing and mobility products, owning the direction of software and data products, engineering systems, internal processes, and business intelligence.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior product manager for electric-vehicle financing and mobility products, owning the direction of software and data products, engineering systems, internal processes, and business intelligence.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 4+ years of product management experience.
- Experience working on a backend or API-first product.
- Experience working on a B2C product.
- Experience with IoT products.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Technical and/or analytical skills, including the ability to conduct complex data analysis independently.
- Proven ability to solve technical and/or analytical problems.
- Experience with IoT products and remote device control best practices.
- Experience integrating SaaS CRM with custom software.
- Experience with agile methodologies and cross-functional team leadership.
- Experience in data-driven decision making and strategy development.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Nairobi, Kenya area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
